title: Sometimes Done
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：sometimes　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sometimes 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Sometimes, in 1978 the postman argued the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② sometimes argued the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1972 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ sometimes right, and the sender who kept it had ④ sometimes fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done sometimes in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He argued the envelope ⑤ sometimes without complaint, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who argued it that week, he argued it ⑥ sometimes in the rain. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ sometimes every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ sometimes careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done sometimes.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she argued the envelope ⑨ sometimes in the rain when nobody else would, and ⑩ Sometimes, she said in 1990, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks sometimes of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how sometimes it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 有时（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had sometimes argued …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 有时（修饰形容词：sometimes right）
C. adv. 间或（评注性状语，置于句首：Sometimes, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 间或（修饰过去分词：had sometimes fetched it）
E. adv. 有时（句末状语：… sometimes without complaint）
F. adv. 有时（句末状语：… sometimes in the rain，第 6 处）
G. adv. 间或（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched sometimes）
H. adv. 间或（修饰形容词：be sometimes careful about the whole business）

answers.why: sometimes 意为“有时”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Sometimes, in 1978 …。
sometimes 意为“有时”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had sometimes argued the envelope。
sometimes 意为“有时”，此处修饰形容词 right（正确）：was sometimes right。
sometimes 意为“间或”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had sometimes fetched it twice。
sometimes 意为“有时”，此处置于句末修饰动词：argued the envelope sometimes without complaint。
sometimes 意为“有时”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it sometimes in the rain。
sometimes 意为“间或”，被动结构 be fetched sometimes 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
sometimes 意为“间或”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be sometimes careful about the whole business。
sometimes 意为“有时”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次争论那件薄薄的信封，副词置于动词之后。
sometimes 意为“间或”，母亲 1990 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Sometimes, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，邮差间或在信箱争论那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Sometimes, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经有时争论那件薄薄的信封。（had sometimes argued …）
那件薄薄的信封当时有时正确。（sometimes right）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经间或把它取过两回。（had sometimes fetched it）
叔叔有时争论那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… sometimes …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最有时。（the most sometimes of all of them）
answers: Sometimes, in 1978 the postman argued the envelope at the box.
Before the June rains the postman had sometimes argued the envelope.
The sender who kept it had sometimes fetched it twice before the winter came.
He argued the envelope sometimes without complaint, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it sometimes in the rain.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sometimes 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Sometimes, in 1978 the postman argued the envelope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the postman had sometimes argued the envelope.
The envelope was sometimes right, or so the list says.
The sender had sometimes fetched it twice before the winter came.
My mother argued the envelope sometimes in the rain when nobody else would.
Sometimes, the office never forgot that part of the story.
